messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High packet loss detected from edge-pop us-east2 -> multiple egress prefixes. Severity: P2. Auto-page sent to oncall.
mira: seeing this in the dashboard, packet loss spikes ~30-60% from 11:03 UTC. Affects streaming and large responses. Routing flaps shown in BGP telemetry.
pagerduty-bot: Paging mira (on-call). Escalation to ashok in 5m if not acknowledged.
mira: on it. acked pager.
ashok: joining. quick sanity: any customer-facing 5xxs? lucy, can you confirm support tickets volume?
lucy: a few customers reporting slow responses and partial streams — not full outages. I've opened a support thread for two enterprise customers on dedicated capacity.
henry: I can see elevated tail latency for synth traffic through us-east2 POP; connection resets in chunked responses. Not present in us-west and eu pops.
net-cdn-team: ping — we see packet loss between POP->origin egress at the regional provider handoff. Provider sent an alert for an upstream router in asn 64500.
mira: do we have traceroutes / captures? henry, can you run a quick mtr to problematic prefix and paste?
henry: ```
mtr -r -c 50 198.51.100.17
Start: Tue Mar 15 11:05:12 2026
HOST: host.local            Loss%   Snt   Last   Avg  Best  Wrst StDev
 1. 10.0.0.1                 0.0%    50    0.6   0.8   0.5   1.4   0.2
 2. 203.0.113.5              0.0%    50    2.1   2.3   1.9   5.0   0.6
 3. 198.51.100.1            45.0%    50   30.2  28.9   1.0  120.0 12.0
 4. 198.51.100.17          45.0%    50   29.8  28.7   2.2  115.0 11.6
```
henry: confirms heavy loss at hop 3, consistent with provider-side packet drop.
mira: OK — immediate mitigation options: 1) Reroute POP traffic away from us-east2 via smart-routing to us-east1/3 (likely increased latency for some customers). 2) Request provider force-failover/maintenance and wait. 3) BGP prepend or adjust local BGP policies to prefer alternate path.
ashok: I'm pushing a temporary reroute policy to divert critical customers to us-east1. Will apply only for prefixes tagged "enterprise-critical".
ashok: command: ```
redwoodctl routing update --pop us-east2 --action divert --target-pop us-east1 --tag enterprise-critical --ttl 300
``` 
ashok: applied for enterprise-critical prefixes. verify please.
mira: monitoring synthetic tests now.
net-cdn-team: provider acknowledges issue: "Investigating high packet loss on transit router, elevated error counters. Mitigation in progress." ETA unknown.
lucy: tell enterprise customers we have diverted their traffic to alternate POPs, small latency increase but restored streaming. Posted to status page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1798502468
henry: synthetics show error percentage dropped from 12%->1.5% for diverted prefixes within 3m. Non-diverted public prefixes still see loss.
mira: action items: - keep diversion for enterprise prefixes - monitor provider updates - prepare wider diversion if SLA impact increases - start incident timeline for postmortem
ashok: expanding diversion to latency-sensitive route group beta-rtg (low-risk) to reduce customer-visible errors. applied.
incident-bot: NOTE: oncall handoff scheduled in 40m to ashok. mira -> ashok handoff prep: summarize actions.
mira: handoff summary (copy into thread): 1) Detected high packet loss at us-east2 POP affecting egress to transit ASN 64500. 2) Diverted enterprise-critical prefixes to us-east1 via redwoodctl (ttl 300). 3) Monitoring shows errors reduced for diverted prefixes. 4) Provider is investigating upstream router; may require maintenance. 5) Support notified customers; status page updated. 6) If provider cannot stabilize within 30-60m, escalate to full POP failover.
ashok: ack. I'll take the next rotation. I'll keep divert rules in place and coordinate with provider for patch timing. If provider wants BGP-level action, I'll coordinate with network ops.
net-cdn-team: provider update: "We will perform a neighbor reset on transit router in 15m; brief packet loss expected during reset. We'll follow up with routing logs." Scheduled at 11:30 UTC.
mira: noted — will coordinate maintenance window notice to affected customers (support + status). lucy, please patch status page with expected brief disruption during provider reset.
lucy: done, added note about maintenance window and that enterprise traffic is diverted.
henry: after reset we should rerun mtr and confirm baseline. also schedule traffic drain if they request full pop failover.
ashok: if reset fails, plan B: full POP failover to us-east1 (announce prefixes from us-east1), will need 8-12m to converge. I'll prepare the playbook.
incident-bot: RESOLVE: bulk of customer errors mitigated for diverted prefixes. Incident remains in-progress for provider fix. Assigned owner: ashok
mira: thanks team. tagging this thread for postmortem creation once resolved. :white_check_mark:
ashok: taking over. closing my end of handoff. ping me directly for urgent escalation.
net-cdn-team: provider: "Reset performed, counter drop to normal levels, loss mitigated across majority of prefixes. Monitoring closely." We'll keep watch for 30m.
henry: confirm post-reset mtr shows loss 0-1% at all hops. Looks stable.
lucy: support volume back to baseline; closing interim tickets; will follow up with customers for RCA tomorrow.
mira: great. leaving notes for PM and incident review. I'll add timeline and metrics to the incident doc.
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS UPDATE: severity downgraded. Oncall owner: ashok. Next: 1) run full traffic sweep 2) collect provider logs 3) schedule postmortem.
ashok: will start collecting BGP dump and provider logs. adding to incident board.
mira: handing off officially — over to ashok. thanks everyone.
ashok: thanks — will keep thread updated and file postmortem once we have provider logs and routing diffs. :thumbsup:
